type: exploratory, post hoc (the pilot plan allowed a spatial-block check only as a labelled deviation)
what: Two-way clustered standard errors (year x 20 km block; Cameron, Gelbach & Miller 2011) for the pilot B/M2 estimate, computed with the confirmatory run_test.fit_twoway on the frozen pilot data, first while writing the confirmatory plan (2026-10-20 ~20:50 ET) and again for plan v1.1.

result.confirmatory_rule: beta +- t(0.975, 32) * max(two-way SE, year-only SE)

note: The two-way SE is smaller than the year-only SE here, so this check does not show the result is robust to spatial correlation; under the stricter confirmatory rule (max of the two SEs, t critical value) the pilot interval is (0.0075, 0.1188), still above 0. The registered pilot decision is unchanged.
